    FROM "RiskAssessments"

artifact_sens AS (
    SELECT 
        "ART_link" as art_id,
        CASE WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'light' = 'High' THEN 10
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'light' = 'Medium' THEN 5
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'light' = 'Low' THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END as light_weight,
        CASE WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'humidity' = 'High' THEN 10
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'humidity' = 'Medium' THEN 5
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'humidity' = 'Low' THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END as humidity_weight,
        CASE WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'temperature' = 'High' THEN 10
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'temperature' = 'Medium' THEN 5
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'temperature' = 'Low' THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END as temp_weight,
        CASE WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'vibration' = 'High' THEN 10
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'vibration' = 'Medium' THEN 5
             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'vibration' = 'Low' THEN 1

             WHEN "env_handling_sensitivity" -> 'environment' ->> 'pollutants' = 'Low' THEN 1

    FROM "SensitivityData"
),
erf_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        art_id,
        ROUND(CAST((light_weight + humidity_weight + temp_weight + vib_weight + poll_weight) / 5.0 AS numeric), 2) as erf
    FROM artifact_sens
),
artifact_env AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.ARTregID as art_id,
        ac.ageYears,
        avg(erc.RH) as avg_rh,
        avg(erc.TEMPc) as avg_temp
    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ac.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" erc ON ca.case_exam = erc.case_link
    GROUP BY ac.ARTregID, ac.ageYears
),

    JOIN "SensitivityData" es ON ac.ARTregID = es.ART_link
